**Applied — 3 receipts, $23,325.50 (all US; UK and DE had nothing in Unapplied Cash)**

| Customer | Receipt | Applied to | Entry | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Health | $9,600.00 (3/12) | INV-1041 $4,350 + INV-1047 $5,250 | JE-00312 | DOC-0185 |
| Corvid Retail | $8,450.00 (3/16) | INV-1044 $8,450 | JE-00313 | DOC-0194 |
| Dunmore Foods | $5,275.50 (3/20) | INV-1049 $5,275.50 | JE-00314 | DOC-0196 |

For each one I confirmed the invoice exists as open AR, no earlier receipt had hit it, and the remittance amount ties to the penny. All three are Dr 2950 / Cr 1100 and under the $10k approval threshold.

**Left in Unapplied Cash — $3,000.00**

- **Evergreen Bank, $3,000 deposited 3/23 (JE-00291).** No remittance advice, and Evergreen has no open invoices — their Jan, Feb and Mar subscriptions ($6,200 each) are all already paid. The amount doesn't match any invoice, so I didn't guess. Logged as **EXC-001**. Most likely a prepayment, duplicate payment or misdirected funds; AR should ask Evergreen what it's for.

US 2950 now ends March at a $3,000 credit, which is exactly that Evergreen item. Memo submitted to the controller.
